controller_description: Execute one declared discovery/inspection controller operation and return its actual receipt-bound observation. Use check_environment, list_runtimes or inspect_runtime for runtime discovery. Use the separate research_run tool for source-code computation. Arguments are specified in assignment.json scientific_software_tools.actions. This executes tools only; it does not create another author or establish scientific validity.
work_instructions: Continue the same research session and complete one development checkpoint on the current question.
The current native tool definitions are authoritative; preserve historical evidence without reusing historical tool interfaces.
Complete current inputs are delivered inline; read files only when useful. You own research choices, design, code and interpretation.
Use read/write/edit for research files inside the writable workspace and inspect_workspace for directory and output existence checks. No shell tool is available.

Use research_tool for discovery and inspection, with operation and arguments from scientific_software_tools.actions. Use check_environment, list_runtimes or inspect_runtime to inspect a runtime. Do not probe runtime paths with shell commands.

Execute complete source code with research_run, supplying its mandatory source, input, purpose and expected fields. Supply input={} for self-contained code and expected=null for a new computation without a reference. Select exactly one declared runtime or environment_ref. The program must print exactly one JSON object to stdout; send explanatory text to stderr.
Native controller tools return the actual observation in the same session. Read that result before choosing subsequent work. Never retry a failed operation or delegate authorship.

Finish by writing response.json as a complete, nonempty JSON object containing research notes and the observed progress. Its initial state is absent. Do not encode tool requests in response.json; call the native controller tools instead.
Notes have no prescribed scientific fields. review_response is optional interface feedback, not scientific validation. A successful tool is not a scientific verdict.
Stop on the first operational error. Preserve the current question, previous failures and historical usage; do not start another topic.
